info.name: 1. WorkFitAI - Auth Service
info.description:
Authentication, Authorization, Role Management & Approval Workflows

Base URL: {{base_url}}/auth
Port: 9080 -> 9085 (gateway)
Consul: auth
DB: MongoDB + Redis

Endpoints coverage:
- Authentication (register, login, verify-otp, 2FA, logout, refresh, me)
- Password Management (forgot, verify-reset-otp, reset, change, set)
- 2FA Management (enable, disable, status)
- Session Management (list, delete, delete-all)
- OAuth (authorize, exchange, link, unlink, linked-accounts, auth-status)
- Approval (pending, approve-hr-manager, approve-hr, reject)
- Permission CRUD + batch
- Role CRUD + batch + clone + permission assignment
- User Role Grant/Revoke + batch
- Audit Log (all logs, by target, by grantor, my trail)
